script_text: Saturn stations retrograde in your 10th House this week, Aquarius, and your career is shifting. Early week, Mars squares Neptune in your 12th House, clouding judgment — avoid contracts Monday and Tuesday. By Wednesday, a trine between Uranus and Jupiter in your 11th House activates social connections and brings romantic encounters. Thursday is the turning point when Venus enters Leo and trines your 1st House Sun, restoring your magnetism. Late week, Mercury enters your 2nd House of finances, revealing a path to negotiate a raise. The weekend asks you to rest and recharge your air energy. Tuesday is your power day because Uranus trines Jupiter in your 11th House, flooding your world with breakthrough opportunities. Wednesday is your worst day because Mars squares Neptune in your 12th House, creating hidden obstacles. This week, Aquarius, trust your instincts over others' advice — Uranus demands self-trust. Follow for updates.
